query: Uni3C controlnet with radial/sage attention throws 'Triton Error [CUDA]: invalid argument' during WanVideoSampler when Uni3C loader attention is set to sage; works with sdpa.

desired.outcome: Maintainer suggested using sdpa for the Uni3C controlnet loader (sage for the model loader is fine) and later pushed a fix ('Possibly fixed it if you want to try still'); user confirmed it works after updating.
desired.quality: Diagnosis identifies the correct root cause; fix actionable and directionally correct.

_tags.hidden_requirement: Tests whether the solver isolates the attention-backend conflict to the Uni3C controlnet loader specifically (sdpa there, sage on the model loader is fine) instead of blindly switching every attention setting or blaming Triton/radial-attention install.
